headline: Diamond Power to add another 132 kV CCV cable line
summary: Diamond Power Infrastructure Ltd announced on Oct 22, 2026 that it will add another CCV line for cables up to 132 kV. The new line is intended to increase transmission capacity and support rising power demand. The expansion could improve the company's order book and revenue outlook. Retail investors may see a positive impact on the stock as the project progresses.

headline: Diamond Power Infrastructure and two others close above VWAP
hook: Technical signal for three specific stocks
summary: Diamond Power Infrastructure is among three stocks that finished the trading session above their Volume Weighted Average Price (VWAP). VWAP is a technical indicator used by traders to determine the average price a stock has traded at throughout the day based on both volume and price. Closing above this level is often interpreted by technical analysts as a sign of bullish momentum. Retail investors often use this metric to gauge intraday trend strength.
why_it_matters: Technical indicators may signal short-term price momentum for these stocks.

headline: Diamond Power, Sky Gold, and Anand Rathi close above VWAP
hook: Technical signal suggests strong intraday buying interest
summary: Diamond Power Infrastructure, Sky Gold, and Anand Rathi Wealth closed above their volume weighted average prices (VWAP) on October 8. Closing above this metric indicates that the final traded price was higher than the average execution price throughout the session. This technical indicator is often used by traders to identify stocks with sustained intraday buying pressure. These three Nifty 500 companies were highlighted for this specific price action.
why_it_matters: Technical indicators may signal short-term momentum for these specific stocks.
